radios.name: TETRA
radios.data: SDS text, status and position reports
radios.limit: Licensed TETRA channels. Direct-mode SDS, status and location interoperability need validation with the team's radios. BDM 31 3L direct mode is unconfirmed.

radios.name: DMR
radios.data: Text; status and positions depend on the module and fleet
radios.limit: Licensed DMR channels. Text formats, location protocols and encryption vary by fleet. NiceRF's public command list does not document a location command. Cross-vendor data and encryption interoperability are unverified.

radios.name: LoRa / Meshtastic
radios.limit: Regional band, transmit power and duty-cycle limits apply. A Meshtastic host and compatible firmware are required; the SX1262 chip alone does not run Meshtastic.

radios.name: APRS
radios.limit: Amateur radio only. A licensed operator is required. No encryption. Not for agency traffic; routes onto APRS must enforce this boundary.

radios.name: HaLow / 802.11ah
radios.data: Selected application messages over a local IP link
radios.modules: Morse Micro MM6108; LILYGO T-HaLow / TX-AH
radios.limit: Regional band and power limits apply. Requires compatible HaLow peers. The satellite path carries selected messages, not a broadband IP connection. Board choice and host integration are under evaluation.

radios.name: 2G cell
radios.data: SMS from phones registered to a local GSM cell
radios.limit: Licensed per site. Each deployment needs its own radio authorization. SIM provisioning, spectrum, timing, RF filtering and compute capacity need validation. This is a local cell, not public-network roaming.

modules.name: Airbus TW1m
modules.note: Public brochure dimensions shown. Location handling and fleet interoperability require bench validation.

modules.name: PMR-R & D BDM 31 3L
facts: 3.7 V; 3.0 A during a TX burst
modules.note: The public datasheet lists TMO only. DMO support, required for the team-radio concept, is unconfirmed.

modules.name: Leonardo ECOS-D MT100-N
facts: 3.3 V UART; AT commands; IP over DMR
modules.note: The datasheet lists DMRA AES-128/256 and ARC4. This does not establish interoperability with a fleet's text, location or encryption implementation.

modules.name: NiceRF DMR818S
facts: 2 W; datasheet specifies 1 W for CE/FCC
modules.note: Text commands are documented; a location command is not. Encryption and text compatibility with other radios remain unverified.

modules.name: Semtech SX1262
modules.note: A radio module, antenna and Meshtastic host are under evaluation. Chip limits are not permission to transmit at those settings.

modules.name: PicoAPRS V4
facts: AX.25 at 1,200 baud; USB KISS TNC
modules.note: VHF model. Amateur radio only, licensed operator, no encryption. Its own battery is separate from the MSC-3 battery concept.
modules.sourceLabel: Maker's public V4 manual, technical specifications, 20/11/2023

modules.name: Morse Micro MM6108
facts: Local IP access for message transport
modules.note: A Morse Micro module and carrier remain under evaluation. The LILYGO T-HaLow board below uses TX-AH; it is a separate candidate.
modules.sourceLabel: Morse Micro public MM6108 product brief

modules.name: LILYGO T-HaLow / TX-AH
modules.note: Board revision, regional RF variant and host interface need confirmation. No Morse Micro chipset is attributed to this board.
modules.sourceLabel: LILYGO public hardware documentation and module specifications

modules.name: PlutoSDR with Osmocom
modules.note: Analog Devices ADALM-PLUTO specifications. GSM operation with Osmocom, RF filtering and processing on the platform require validation. Licensed per site.
modules.sourceLabel: Analog Devices public ADALM-PLUTO technical specifications

modules.name: Ground Control RockBLOCK 9704
facts: 48 × 52 × 16 mm / less than 35 g, excluding antenna
modules.note: Always fitted in the MSC-3 concept; module integration is under evaluation. Requires an approved antenna and satellite service. The payload limit is a modem specification, not a validated MSC-3 payload size.
